reason: Decide Enyuan benefit using the actual giver passed by C++; never infer it from stale xuanhuo flags or the current turn.
old:
sgs.ai_skill_invoke.enyuan = function(self, data)
	local damage = data:toDamage()
	local from = damage.from
	local source = self.room:getCurrent()
	local xuanhuotarget 
	if from then
		return not self:isFriend(from)
	else
		for _, player in sgs.qlist(self.room:getAlivePlayers()) do
			if player:hasFlag("xuanhuo_target") then
				xuanhuotarget = player
			end
		end
		if xuanhuotarget then
			return self:isFriend(xuanhuotarget)
		else
			return self:isFriend(source)
		end
	end
end
new:
sgs.ai_skill_invoke.enyuan = function(self, data)
    local giver = data:toPlayer()
    if giver then return self:isFriend(giver) end
    local damage = data:toDamage()
    return damage.from ~= nil and not self:isFriend(damage.from)
end

reason: Fix Yanxiao target insertion and nested callbacks; prioritize controlled allies, allow the last diamond, and avoid idle self placement.
old:
sgs.ai_skill_use_func.YanxiaoCard=function(card,use,self)
	local cards = self.player:getCards("he")
	cards=sgs.QList2Table(cards)
	self:sortByUseValue(cards,true)

	local target
	for _, friend in ipairs(self.friends_noself) do
		local judges = friend:getJudgingArea()
		if not judges:isEmpty() and friend:getPile("smile"):isEmpty() then
			for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
				if card:getSuit() == sgs.Card_Diamond and self.player:getHandcardNum() > 1 then
					use.card = sgs.Card_Parse("@YanxiaoCard=" .. card:getEffectiveId())
					target = friend
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if target then break end
	end
	if not target and self.player:getPile("smile"):isEmpty() then
		for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
			if card:getSuit() == sgs.Card_Diamond  then
				use.card = sgs.Card_Parse("@YanxiaoCard=" .. card:getEffectiveId())
				target = self.player
				break
			end
		end
	if target then
		if use.to then
			use.to:append(target)
		end
	end
end

sgs.ai_skill_use_func.YanxiaoCard=function(card,use,self)
    local cards = sgs.QList2Table(self.player:getCards("he"))
    self:sortByKeepValue(cards)
    local diamond
    for _, candidate in ipairs(cards) do
        if candidate:getSuit() == sgs.Card_Diamond then diamond = candidate; break end
    end
    if not diamond then return end

    local target
    for _, friend in ipairs(self.friends_noself) do
        if not friend:getJudgingArea():isEmpty() and friend:getPile("smile"):isEmpty() then
            target = friend
            break
        end
    end
    if not target and not self.player:getJudgingArea():isEmpty() and self.player:getPile("smile"):isEmpty() then
        target = self.player
    end
    if not target then return end
    use.card = sgs.Card_Parse("@YanxiaoCard=" .. diamond:getEffectiveId())
    if use.to then use.to:append(target) end
end

reason: Use real Pindian data to spend a legal low-cost hand card only when it changes an ally-versus-enemy outcome; provide the card response callback.
new:
sgs.ai_skill_choice.fuzuo = function(self, choices, data)
    self.fuzuo_card_id = nil
    local pd = data:toPindian()
    if not pd or not pd.from or not pd.to then return "cancel" end
    local from_number, to_number = pd.from_card:getNumber(), pd.to_card:getNumber()
    local target, needed
    if self:isFriend(pd.from) and self:isEnemy(pd.to) and from_number <= to_number then
        target, needed = pd.from, to_number - from_number + 1
    elseif self:isFriend(pd.to) and self:isEnemy(pd.from) and from_number > to_number then
        target, needed = pd.to, from_number - to_number
    else
        return "cancel"
    end
    local cards = sgs.QList2Table(self.player:getHandcards())
    self:sortByKeepValue(cards)
    for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
        if card:getEffectiveId() ~= pd.from_card:getEffectiveId() and card:getEffectiveId() ~= pd.to_card:getEffectiveId()
            and card:getNumber() < 8 and math.floor(card:getNumber() / 2) >= needed then
            self.fuzuo_card_id = card:getEffectiveId()
            return target:getGeneralName()
        end
    end
    return "cancel"
end

sgs.ai_skill_cardask["@fuzuo_card"] = function(self, data, pattern)
    local id = self.fuzuo_card_id
    self.fuzuo_card_id = nil
    if id then
        for _, card in sgs.qlist(self.player:getHandcards()) do
            if card:getEffectiveId() == id and card:getNumber() < 8 then return tostring(id) end
        end
    end
    return "."
end
